BusinessModel: Company builds metros, bridges, roads, ports, jetties, tunnels and dams. Sells EPC construction services mainly to government clients like railways, NHAI and port authorities. Shapoorji Pallonji Group controls it.
RevenueStreams: Transportation (metros/roads/bridges) largest segment; marine works; building & housing; hydro & underground - FY25 mix per company reports; order book ~Rs 40,000+ cr FY25
Expenses: Construction materials & subcontracting dominant; finance costs Rs 674 cr FY26; depreciation Rs 454 cr FY26; interest ~5-6% of sales FY26
TAM: India infra pipeline ~Rs 100+ lakh crore over 2020-25 (National Infrastructure Pipeline, govt estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Execution pace on transportation order book; specialised marine/tunnel projects; finance costs & 105 debtor days dragging profit

BusinessModel: Company makes solar PV modules and builds solar plants as EPC contractor. Sells to NTPC, Adani Green, Tata Power and other developers. Listed Sept 2025 after a large IPO.
RevenueStreams: Solar modules dominant revenue; EPC services; new cell manufacturing & IPP revenue starting FY26 (mix split not disclosed here)
Expenses: Raw materials (cells, glass, EVA) ~60-70% of revenue per DRHP; interest Rs 160 cr FY26; depreciation Rs 162 cr FY26
TAM: India targets ~500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030 (govt); global module market US$100 bn+ (industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Module volumes & TOPCon capacity utilisation; module price vs raw material cost spread; cell/IPP entry adding margin

RevenueStreams: Domestic modules dominant FY26; US (Americas) module sales; EPC/O&M and emerging IPP/wafer-cell integration (mix not disclosed here)
Expenses: Raw materials (cells, glass, EVA) ~70%+ of revenue per DRHP; interest Rs 280 cr FY26; depreciation Rs 990 cr FY26
TAM: India ~500 GW by 2030 target; US utility-scale solar market tens of GW/yr; global solar equipment hundreds of US$ bn (industry estimates)

BusinessModel: Company advises businesses on IPOs, fund raises and M&A deals, plus asset and wealth management. Earns fees when deals close. Boutique investment bank, formerly Investec Capital India; listed Dec 2024.
RevenueStreams: ECM (IPO/QIP) fees dominant; M&A & advisory fees; AMC/wealth management fees growing (FY25 mix not disclosed)
Expenses: Employee costs & bonus pool the dominant expense head; interest minimal Rs 9 cr FY25; depreciation Rs 14 cr FY25
TAM: India ECM fees US$1 bn+ in boom year 2024 (league tables); MF AUM Rs 70+ lakh crore (AMFI 2025)

BusinessModel: Company gives small home loans to self-employed borrowers in tier-2/3 towns, secured by property. Borrows from banks and bonds, lends at a spread. Listed Dec 2023.
RevenueStreams: Interest income on home loans dominant (AUM ~Rs 6,000+ cr FY25); small ticket sizes avg ~Rs 10 lakh per company data
Expenses: Interest cost Rs 446 cr FY25 (biggest head); operating expenses Rs 417 cr FY25; credit provisions rising with book
TAM: Self-employed affordable housing finance in tier-2/3 India estimated Rs 10+ lakh cr addressable (industry/NHB estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Net interest income at ~9%+ NIM; cost of funds on Rs 6,246 cr borrowings FY25; credit costs on small-town book

BusinessModel: Company runs the ixigo travel app for booking train, flight and bus tickets plus train tracking. Owns ConfirmTatkal and AbhiBus. Earns booking fees, commissions and ad money. Listed June 2024.
RevenueStreams: Train ticketing & ancillary fees core niche; flights and AbhiBus bus bookings FY26; advertising (mix split not disclosed here)
Expenses: Employee and marketing the biggest heads; cost of sales/agent incentives; other income Rs 66 cr FY26 from treasury cash
TAM: Indian online travel market US$40 bn+ growing double digits (industry estimates); tens of millions of daily rail travellers
PL_Top3_Contributors: Train-ticket volumes & convenience fees; flight/bus plus ad revenue; treasury interest padding FY26 PAT of Rs 96 cr

BusinessModel: Company sells advertising, media planning, market research and customer-data analytics services to consumer and financial clients. Decades-old ad-services group; listed March 2024.
RevenueStreams: Media buying & integrated marketing services dominant; analytics & customer data practice growing (mix split not disclosed here)
Expenses: Employee costs the dominant expense; other expenses incl media pass-through; interest minimal Rs 3 cr FY26
TAM: Indian ad industry ~Rs 1 lakh crore+ growing high single/double digits (FICCI-EY estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Client media budgets; employee cost & utilisation; analytics arm margins vs ad-buying margins

BusinessModel: Company makes agrochemical formulations and technicals - insecticides, fungicides, pesticides - from Gujarat plants. Sells to farmers via distributors and exports. Listed Aug 2025.
RevenueStreams: Domestic formulations dominant; exports; technical-grade agrochemicals new capacity (FY25 mix not disclosed)
Expenses: Raw materials (imported technicals/intermediates) dominant ~bulk of Rs 447 cr FY25 expenses; interest Rs 7 cr FY25; depreciation Rs 8 cr FY25
TAM: Indian agrochemical market ~Rs 60,000-70,000 crore, mid-to-high single digit growth (industry/CRISIL-type estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Formulation volumes via distributor network; raw material (imported technicals) costs; export realisations & new capacity use

BusinessModel: Company builds roads and highways as an EPC contractor, mainly for NHAI and government authorities. Gets paid as work completes. Listed Aug 2025.
RevenueStreams: Road/highway EPC dominant; other civil works small (mix split not disclosed; order book data not found)
Expenses: Construction materials & subcontracting dominant; interest Rs 20 cr FY26; depreciation Rs 6 cr FY26; debtor-heavy working capital

RevenueStreams: Gathiya & namkeen dominant; papad; farali & other snacks FY26 (mix split not disclosed)
